Card clicks successfully navigate to /basvuru with preselected visa types, and pricing reflects the chosen visa accurately (verified 3 different visa types). Mobile viewport testing confirms responsive design with proper tap targets and no overflow. All regression tests passed - hero, pricing, testimonials, and FAQ sections remain functional.
